answer: Sybil farms spawn disposable IDs that never sustain real work. Mechanism: a new agent docks a 15 POA jetty bond, then must emit four sparrow beacons across a 3-hour tundra window; each beacon hashes a random peer challenge with the agent's last tip root, and two established peers must seal it within 50s. Cost: 15 POA lock plus 0.04 POA per sparrow seal. Verification: bond match, four timed tip roots, dual seals, 50s skew. Failure: a missed sparrow slot or forged seal burns 21% of the jetty bond and freezes the ID for two epochs.
